research_question: Can satellite AI help assess developing high water when a gauge's data are late or stop arriving?
supporting_questions: How does assessment accuracy change as the last available discharge observation gets older?
Do frozen EO representations reduce that loss beyond the same available rainfall/discharge information and simple fallbacks?
Does any benefit persist after accounting for EO age, season and historical-archive coverage, and is it consistent between the Dutch and German study gauges?

scope.event_selection: eligible census, no random event/gauge sample
scope.interruption: local delivered station feed including valid sensor redundancy
scope.rainfall: observed through issue under common nominal availability; no future rainfall
scope.other_feeds: not masked; no claim to have benchmarked a peer-gauge rescue model
scope.claim: retrospective counterfactual observation-availability assessment, not as-issued warning verification
scope.time_axis: verified UTC hour end; Q ending at issue is eligible, first future value ends at issue + 1h

calendar.landmark: first observed-prefix 10mm accumulation, replacing fixed six-hour landmark

primary.qualification: first observed-prefix >=10mm in any of eight shared NL/DE catchments
primary.landmark: first hourly end timestamp at which qualification is known
primary.boundary_uncertainty: retain source flags; audit affected cases

old_six_hour_calendar.role: supporting calendar check, not primary eligibility cap

calendar.high_water_catalogue_role: conditional stress/case review only; not primary issue clock
calendar.new_eligibility: rebuild each issue history and next-24h outcome from continuous hourly data; old 72h arrays and old eligibility flags are not sufficient
calendar.german_coverage_audit: completed and adopted: eight-gauge regional shared grouping, 481 episodes; old 468 retained as historical source calendar

situations.release_time: measurement_time if measurement_time <= landmark; otherwise unavailable during sequence
measurement_time if measurement_time <= landmark - 6h; otherwise unavailable during sequence

equivalence: deduplicate identical gauge-storm-issue/latest-Q information states; retain labels, do not inflate independent N

donors.primary: same gauge, earlier completed storm, same relative issue offset and availability mask
donors.cross_river_role: supporting area-based transfer check, not mandatory new model
donors.short_archive: retain row and actual ensemble size; separate paired five-member scores and applicability
donors.paired_scarcity_curve: fixed compatible donors across delay levels; natural coverage reported separately
donors.reservoir: eligible earlier completed storms from adopted 481-episode eight-gauge regional calendar; old 468 calendar retained as historical source, not a 126-query cap

comparators: restricted conventional plus identical sine/cosine season
natural-archive conventional without season as supporting control
season-aware restricted conventional plus each EO encoder

eo.context_freeze: pre-landmark EO held fixed across first 24h; update its age
eo.availability: all source acquisitions/bins end by landmark; release time unknown unless independently recorded
eo.pretraining: document checkpoint training dates/possible study overlap; not an as-issued model replay
eo.fusion: equal weights on squared prior-pair-distance-normalized conventional and EO distances; conventional block includes season
eo.new_inference_rule: reuse as-of-compatible held contexts; inventory newly needed contexts and source gaps at rescheduled landmarks, then extract only genuinely absent/changed contexts

outcomes.primary: mean hourly empirical CRPS across next 24h
outcomes.pooled_units: mm/h specific discharge using held catchment area
outcomes.p99_warning_thresholds: verification labels only; not input triggers or native-unit Q>=1 duration
outcomes.window_source: continuous hourly Q rebuilt at new issue times, not old t0+72h arrays

uncertainty.pairing: same storm/year draws across methods, issues and scenarios; retain whole storm together
report: direct EO increment by age interaction
uncertainty.weighting: explicit equal gauge and issue weights; repeated masks are not independent storms
uncertainty.recovered_loss_fraction: secondary, undefined unless sparse minus full loss is positive

ttm.fair_control: identically shifted raw history with permitted state
ttm.missingness: no hidden-tail fill or zero padding; natural interior gaps mark that representation unsupported

alphaearth.controls: area, season and geographic context; no current river-state claim

recommended_data_additions.purpose: one supporting antecedent-state control and interpretation
recommended_data_additions.availability_limit: retrospective reanalysis is not as-issued operational data
recommended_data_additions.api_variable_names: confirm current CDS request identifiers and downloaded units when implementing downloader; labels here describe scientific fields

recommended_data_additions.source: compatible held EO catalogue and open source providers
recommended_data_additions.purpose: recover actual context/acquisition gaps over complete study domain/period
recommended_data_additions.essential_for_primary: only for an otherwise unsupported EO arm, not for conventional analysis

recommended_data_additions.purpose: retained receipt timestamps, known station-feed interruption periods and contemporaneous backup delivery if available

acquisition.note: Acquisition only; no new embeddings, simulation scores or adopted regional-catalogue results.
